CoreConfig.description: One `[cores.<name>]` entry: facts about a symbolic core name that hold in every language.

meta.description: A JSON Schema for the `meta` of every endpoint on this core. Without one, each such endpoint declares its own `meta: {}`.
meta.title: Meta

CoreConfig.title: CoreConfig

ExtraEntry.description: A hand-written Python class a generated router folds in beside its generated endpoints.

file.description: The module defining the class, without `.py`, beside the router's `__init__.py`.
file.title: File

replaces.description: The generated endpoint this class stands in for, by its attribute name. Without it, the class is added beside the generated ones.
replaces.title: Replaces

ExtraEntry.title: ExtraEntry

name.description: Generated root struct name, e.g. `KuCoin`; `[python].name` by default.
name.title: Name

package.description: Directory of the generated root package under `src`; `[project].name` by default.
package.title: Package

src.description: Directory the package lives under, relative to the project root.
src.title: Src

root.description: Directory holding `go.mod`, relative to the project root.
root.title: Root

NewParam.description: A `new()` keyword as a table: its type, and whether a caller must pass it.

required.description: Whether a caller must pass it; `false` makes it optional, `None` by default.
required.title: Required

NewParam.title: NewParam

PolicyTable.description: `[policy]`: what the client may do on its own behalf.

rate.description: Requests per second the client paces itself to; unpaced when absent.
rate.title: Rate

retry.description: Whether the client retries a failed request on its own.
retry.title: Retry

refuse.description: Endpoint ids the client refuses to call, e.g. `account.withdraw`.
refuse.title: Refuse

PolicyTable.title: PolicyTable

name.description: The project's name; the package names default to it.
name.title: Name

name.description: Generated root class name, e.g. `KuCoin`; PascalCase of `[project].name` by default.
name.title: Name

package.description: Import name of the generated package (`petstore` for `src/petstore/`); `[project].name` by default.
package.title: Package

src.description: Directory the package lives under, relative to the project root.
src.title: Src

ruff.description: Ruff config `truewire generate` formats with, relative to the project root; the one shipped with truewire by default.
ruff.title: Ruff

pyright.description: Run pyright over the package after generating; also on when a `pyrightconfig.json` is at the root.
pyright.title: Pyright

backend.description: A Python module, relative to the project root, exporting a `generator` that customizes generation.
backend.title: Backend

cores.description: Core name -> the hand-written class it resolves to; `router.json`'s `core` picks one. At least the root's.
cores.title: Cores

extras.description: Router node (dotted, `"indexer.data"`) -> hand-written classes folded into it.
extras.title: Extras

PythonCoreConfig.description: One `[python.cores.<name>]` entry: the hand-written Python class a core name resolves to, and how it is built.

base.description: The class this core name resolves to, as `module.path:ClassName`.
base.title: Base

children.description: Child attribute -> the field of this class forwarded to it, e.g. `{rest = "rest_client"}`. Without it, every child gets the one client.
children.title: Children

forward.description: `new()` keywords passed on from the composing class's same-named fields. Declaring it, even empty, builds the class through `new(client, *, ...)`.
forward.title: Forward

params.description: `new()` keywords a caller supplies: name -> type (`"pkg.core:Network"`, a builtin), or a `{type, required}` table for an optional one.
params.title: Params

name.description: Generated root struct name, e.g. `KuCoin`; `[python].name` by default.
name.title: Name

package.description: Directory of the generated modules under `src`; `[project].name` by default.
package.title: Package

src.description: Directory the package lives under, relative to the project root.
src.title: Src

SecretsTable.description:
`[secrets]`: the environment variables a caller sets, by name only. Their values go in
`.env`, which is git-ignored, and nowhere else.

required.title: Required

optional.description: Variables that unlock more of the API when set.
optional.title: Optional

dir.description: The spec directory, relative to `truewire.toml`; it holds `endpoints/` and `schemas.json`.
dir.title: Dir

name.description: Generated root class name, e.g. `KuCoin`; `[python].name` by default.
name.title: Name

package.description: Directory of the generated package under `src`; `[project].name` by default.
package.title: Package

src.description: Directory the package lives under, relative to the project root.

extras.description: Router node (dotted, `"spot.account"`; `""` for the root) -> hand-written classes folded into it.

TypescriptExtraEntry.description: A hand-written TypeScript class a generated router folds in beside its generated endpoints.

file.description: The module exporting the class, without `.ts`, beside the router's `index.ts`.
file.title: File

methods.description: The methods of the class the router exposes, by their TypeScript names.
methods.title: Methods

replaces.description: The generated child endpoint this class stands in for, by its spec segment. Without it, the class is added beside the generated ones.

field.description: Under a composite router, the field of its core the class is built from; `client` by default.
